description: AG2 agent run with one tool call, traced by AG2's telemetry middleware.
notes: TelemetryMiddleware on the harness provider, with agent_name weather_agent, provider_name openai and the model name. Each chat span is followed by a record_usage model_call span that repeats its tokens (ag2.span.type usage). The usage span is a span, not an llm span, so the tokens count once (D-IN-23 item 1). ag2.usage.event_id is a random id per run and is volatile.
